question: Which vessel is declared supreme among all vessels in this teaching?
premises: The skull associated with Viśvāmitra is named
It is described as supreme among all vessels
inference: The skull of Viśvāmitra is declared the supreme vessel of all.
uncertainties: The identity and ritual significance of viśvāmitrakapāla depend on broader textual context
plain_english: O beloved, the skull of Viśvāmitra is the supreme vessel of all.
